g.text: (a) Random forests trained on 6 000 pixels of a synthetic six-class scene (region A, as in the land-cover figure) and tested on 12 000 pixels of another scene whose
soils, vegetation and haze shift towards a drier climate (shift 1: soils up to 35 % brighter, plant NIR 25 % lower, more haze). (b) A 10⁶-pixel map finds 65 % of 30
000 loss pixels and adds 4 000 false ones; 400 simulated surveys per sample size, estimator of Olofsson et al. (2014).
